name: card-grid
note: Stress card grid (corpus/stress/card-grid): a display:grid track of flex-column cards. Packs grid-template-columns/gap, flex column layout with justify-content/align-items, padding/margin, border + border-radius, box-shadow, background-color, a CSS-variable-free layout, and a width media query that switches the column count between the small and desktop viewports. All four layers must match Chrome at both declared viewports (360x640 and 1280x800).
